summary: Prefabricated fire lookout on Mount Artaban, Gambier Island, dated to 1957; the plan's text says it fell and its survey table says it was removed, leaving a footing and an iron hook. The summit is a public hiking destination.

facts.design: Pre-fabricated tower; pre-assembled panels lifted in by helicopter
facts.status_note: The plan's text says the tower has fallen, with its footings and an iron hook still in place. Its survey table says the lookout has since been removed. The doczz copy describes a collapse with debris on the ground.

access.note: Hiking trails reach the summit inside the Mount Artaban Nature Reserve, which the Islands Trust Fund holds.

visit.trail_note: No tower stands on the summit. Start from public docks at Camp Fircom, Halkett Bay Marine Park or Camp Artaban; about two hours' walk from Camp Fircom. No campsites.

events.note: Fire lookout tower on the summit, dated 1957 in the reserve plan on a personal communication from John Parminter
Human-caused fire burned the whole reserve area, decades before the tower was built
Last use of the tower, probably around 1970; the plan says the exact date is not known

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The plan text says the tower has fallen down, with its footings and iron hook still in place; its survey table says the lookout has since been removed; the doczz copy describes a collapsed tower with debris. The story reports the plan's two statements without choosing between them.

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'unknown' is superseded by the plan. No source names anyone who staffed the tower. The 1957 date rests on a personal communication cited in the plan. The plan text and survey table say the tower fell or was removed; the doczz copy mentions debris and a clean-up recommendation whose outcome no source records. Brief has no local_unit; Gambier Island is in the Islands Trust area, and I did not invent a local_unit. Trail facts come from the Gambier Island Conservancy page; the Islands Trust PDF and doczz copy differ in wording, so check both before any edit.
